page.layout: One printed page: running text in one column at right; marginal notes in the left margin beside the text (two notes, marked 333 and 334). Page number and running head at top. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.p: Cardinalem creavit, & suorum omnium consilio–rum participem atque adjutorem esse voluit Anno salutis MCLXXVII. Unde forte orta Alberici opinio in eam historiæ speciem coaluit, quam bo-na fide literis consignavit. Verior est Magistri titulus, qui passim Gratiano tribuitur, vide sis Gloss. in cap. 2. dist. 68. Qui ista ætate Doctorem vel juris interpretem donabat. Sic quoque Tancredus Glossator, Magister appellatur. Vid. Gud. Panciroll. de Clar. leg. interp. lib. 3. c. 4. Alber. Gentil. de libr. Jur. Canon. cap. 2. pag. 21. Postquam Opus Gratiani editum & Scholis ad prælegendum & explicandum traditum esset, jam statim accesserunt Glossographi, qui notas & explicationes ad Decretum scribe-rent; Quorum Primi memorantur Laurentius Patria Cremensis. Abbas in c. cum Johannes. num. 13. de fide instrum. Vincentius Castellionus Mediolanensis Summus Canonista, Abbas cap. si quis contra sub. n. 13. de for. compet. & Bernardi Bottoni Præceptor, quem tamen Oldradus in consil. 69. in fin. Hispanum fuisse adfirmat. Item Hugutio, vel ut alii Hugo Vercellis, quæ ejus patria fuit, postea Ferrariæ Episcopus, de quo quædam etiam habet Anton. Augustin. libr. 2. dial. 9. pag. 448. & seqq. Præterea Joh. Semeca Teutonicus, qui an-teriorum
main_text.note: 333. Verior titulus Magistri; qui tum Doctoribus dabatur.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are set in small type; the note 333 reads "Verior titulus Magistri; qui tum Doctoribus dabatur." and note 334 reads "Glossatores Decreti." Line-end words "anteriorum" continue as "teriorum" printed at the foot as catchword-like line; the last line is set right-aligned. Some words are slightly blurred (e.g. "Semeca", "Alberici") and read as printed.
